pcs.pc_description: ensure that ambient conditions are suitable for the client and the service procedures to be carried out in a hygienic, safe and disinfected environment such as using air purifiers to reduce dust, dander, smoke, allergens & odour resulting in a healthier, fresher & cleaner environment, restructuring the workplace set-up, by keeping a minimum distance of 2 meters in between two clientele, practicing social distancing by avoiding handshakes/ hugs to coworkers/ clientele, etc.
identify and select suitable equipment and products required for the respective services/ session
set up the area for services/ session in adherence to the organizational/ beauty salon/ centre's guidelines

prepare sterilisation solution as per organizational/ salon standards using approved products and as per manufacturers instructions
sterilize, disinfect the area as per organizational standards using recommended solutions and conditions

dispose waste materials in adherence to the industry requirements; waste materials such as disposable linen, disposable head bands, disposable gowns, disposable apron, disposable face mask, disposable gloves, etc.
identify ways to optimize usage of material including water in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages occurred while providing services
identify and segregate recyclable, non- recyclable and hazardous waste generated in separate bin
store the unused disposable material properly in a dedicated area; material such as disposable masks, gloves, etc.
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are switched off when not in use
store records, materials and equipment securely in line with the policies
conduct awareness program (such as for Covid19) for the employees and display posters/ signage's promoting regular hand-washing and respiratory hygiene in the premises
set up and promote digital modes of payment to lessen any kind of cross infection

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory and simple spa services and assistive tasks for advanced spa services

pcs.pc_description: check and prepare the service area is prepared as per Spa therapists requirement for service and organisational standards
ensure all equipment is safe for use, clean and prepared as per service requirement Equipment: Steamer, heaters, etc

arrange tools, products and other materials that are safe and fit for the purpose based on the guidelinesProducts: Hair and body shampoo, exfoliating products, salts, creams and oils, essences, mud, clay, sand, herbs, petroleum jelly, face moisturizers, etc. Tools: Comb, hair dryers, bowls, spatulas, brushes, etc. Materials: Robe, slippers, disposable briefs, headband, towels, ear plugs, ear buds, etc
prepare massage oil or cream and other equipment for spa services as per manufacturers guidelines
prepare the post care product tray
greet the client, and ensure the client is comfortable
identify any contra indications on client, if any that may restrict services, act according to organisational standards to address these, verify with the supervisor where required
provide the client appropriate materials in preparation for service procedures (Materials: Robe, slippers, disposable briefs, headband, towels, ear plugs, etc.)
guide the client to the service area safely and politely
perform foot ritual including foot cleaning, disinfecting and wiping
position self and client in a manner, to ensure privacy, comfort and wellbeing, throughout the service
explain accurately the service procedure and provide information about products used (oils and creams) to the customer, prior to service
provide correct products, tools, materials and other items to the spa therapist as required during the service
take precautions and work in a manner to maintain guest privacy and modesty during the service
prepare the service area for exfoliations services

carry out exfoliation services under supervision of the massager (masseuse) using various wrap materials Exfoliation services: apply exfoliation product using hands or brushes, wrap for constant heat, keep on for specified timing as per manufacturers and supervisor instructions, remove with body sponges, steamed towels, etc. Wrap materials: Foil, plastic and fabric
carry out dry brushing
apply mask and body wrap, remove without making the area messy
ensure client is not left unattended at any stage
identify contra-actions and necessary subsequent actions
robe the client and guide for bathing and other services
accurately record the therapy details and store information securely in line with the organizations policies
shut down equipment safely, and as per manufacturers instructions
ensure work area is left clean, post service
dispose waste materials safely and hygienically as per organisational standards
adhere to the health and safety standards laid out by the manufacturer and organization
record details of the procedure accurately as per organisational policy and approved practice
store information securely in line with the salons policies
ask questions to check with the client their satisfaction with the finished result
thank customer for feedback post-service, where customer is not satisfied with service take actions to resolve matter to customer satisfaction or apologise for the same and refer to supervisor
